messages:
Maya: Morning fools. Cat + coffee attacked my router at 08:57. Router gave its life. pic: https://i.imgur.com/RouterCat.jpg :skull_and_crossbones:
Sam: oh noooooo 😂 post the chaos pls
Maya: posted — rotated masterpiece. wifi was gone for ~15m, had to hotspot my phone, sorry if I missed standup 😬
Linh: Ritual 1: unplug, wait 30s, replug. Ritual 2: `sudo systemctl restart networking` (obv kidding but it sounds fancy) :stuck_out_tongue:
Carlos: Every home office needs a spare travel router. Bought one after my toddler ate ethernet cable. Amazon link (not sponsored): https://amzn.to/spare-router
Zoe: @Maya you OK? keyboard? laptop?
Maya: Laptop fine, keyboard survived by a hair. Cat is smug. Moral: never place router at cat-level.
Sam: tip: put router on a shelf and a little sticky note that says "do not drink" to shame the cat :cat:
NetBot: ISP alert: outage detected for Maya's IP block 09:04-09:20. Auto-fallback to cellular hotspot triggered.
Linh: We should start a 'WFH fails' Friday thread — this would be front-page material.
Carlos: Vote: yes. Also pro tip — if you hotspot, lower screen brightness and toggle battery saver, the phone dies fast otherwise.
Maya: Thanks for the life hacks. I'll mount the router on a wall and buy a tiny shrine for it. :seedling:
